description: Dated events on the site's history timeline: measures the user logged themselves, completed quests, fixed issues, ticked plan steps, CMS edits, detected wins, scans and Google ranking updates (core, spam …) with their rollout dates. Use it to explain why a curve moved, what was changed when, or whether a measure worked; pair it with traffic_trend. Free domains only get the last 28 days. Responses follow the account language (German by default).

domainId.description: Domain id of one of the user's projects, as returned by list_domains.

kinds.description: Only these kinds. Omit for all except scans.

path.description: Only events of this page (plus site-wide ones).
